content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was the improper handling of the `drc_slab` structure, which was initially created as a per-network namespace resource. This was leading to a potential circular locking dependency and deadlock situation when multiple threads tried to acquire locks on the slab and other structures simultaneously. By changing `drc_slab` from a per-network instance to a global instance, the circular dependency was resolved, preventing the warning and potential deadlock situations in the kernel space.
